author: Tekcrezec162
body:
I was daydreaming about some rpg action game thingie and I thought of this idea,yes I'm a nub C:
So the point of this game is basically to wait for 10 players to join a room to fight a series of ridiculously over-powered mobs.
There is a level limit and the final level would be Level 25(as in different levels,the harder the mobs)
So there are 5 classes in this gamemode,they are all equal in power and no class is better than the other
Classes:
-Warrior
Full Iron Armor and an Iron Sword,the pretty simple class.
-Hunter
Full Leather with An Infinity 1,Power 2 Bow,the ranged and tactical class.
-Medic
Golden Helmet,Chestplate and Leggings,Leather Boots with 8 Splash Healing Potions and 2 Regeneration Splash Potions,1 Wood Sword
The support for the group ^.^
-Sorcerer
1 Chainmail Helmet with 3 Sticks that casts different spells,1 casts a bolt of lightning with a cool down of 5 seconds,another shoots 3 fireballs in a horizontal pattern,last stick casts a blast of energy that knockbacks a mob but deals no damage,right click to cast the spells
The Damage Dealer of the team :)
-Tank
Diamond Helmet and Chestplate,Iron Leggings and Leather Boots and 1 Stone Sword
The Damage Absorber :D
After you kill the overpowered mob,you have a time-out of 20 seconds,you will be awarded with 10 points,increasing by 5 points after each wave,the points can be spent to buy certain items from a shop.The main purpose of the game is to reach the last level.I will leave the exp rewarding after each level,items in the shop,and the overpowered mobs to the staff and community.
Thanks for reading this minigame suggestion,and thank you for keeping with me till the end of this topic as it is insanely long C:
Here are some mobs I made up so it wouldn't be as hard for the staff if this idea is accepted
Level 1
Zangreth The Undead Demigod
Zombie with Resistance 10 and Strength 3 with Full Leather
Level 2
Yvulatis The Skeletal Archer
Skeleton that has 2x the fire rate of a normal skeleton and Resistance 5,bow also has Punch 1
Level 3
Spiros The Spider Menance 
Spider with Strength 3 and Regen 8
Level 4
Ishcark the Spectre of The Void
Zombie with Resistance 15 and Full Iron Armor with A Stone Sword that has Sharpness 2
Level 5 
Nekcros The Vengeful Spirit
Blaze that has 2x Fire Rate of a Normal Blaze with Resistance 15 and Regeneration 3
